description: Searches the local footage index built by index_footage, entirely offline -- no Premiere request. Find the right clip before importing it by filtering on filename substring, file extension, codec, duration/resolution/frame-rate ranges, and whether the file has audio or video. Returns matches with their distilled technical summary. Build or refresh the index with index_footage first.

codec.description: Match a video OR audio codec name (e.g. "h264", "prores", "pcm_s24le").

extension.description: Match a single file extension (with or without the dot).

hasAudio.description: Require (true) or exclude (false) files with an audio stream.

hasVideo.description: Require (true) or exclude (false) files with a video stream.

indexPath.description: Which index JSON to read. Defaults to PREMIERE_MCP_FOOTAGE_INDEX or ~/.premiere-mcp/footage-index.json.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100).

maxDurationSeconds.description: Only files at most this long.

minDurationSeconds.description: Only files at least this long.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the full file path (filename or folder).

name: search_footage
